from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from lxml import etree

prs = Presentation("deck.pptx")
W, H = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height

def luminance(rgb):
    r, g, b = rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]
    return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b

for slide in prs.slides:
    # The page's own ground is the last full-bleed "ground" shape; the mark
    # goes just above it so every piece of copy stays on top of the mark.
    grounds = [s for s in slide.shapes if "ground" in s.name.lower()]
    ground_rgb = (255, 255, 255)
    if grounds:
        try:
            ground_rgb = tuple(grounds[-1].fill.fore_color.rgb)
        except Exception:
            pass
    ink = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) if luminance(ground_rgb) < 128 else RGBColor(0x1D, 0x27, 0x33)

    box_w, box_h = Inches(9.0), Inches(2.4)
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(int((W - box_w) / 2), int((H - box_h) / 2), box_w, box_h)
    box.name = "ThinkSlides:watermark"
    box.rotation = -30
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = False
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = "DRAFT"
    run.font.size = Pt(150)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = ink
    # 12% opaque so the copy over it stays legible
    srgb = run._r.find(qn("a:rPr")).find(qn("a:solidFill")).find(qn("a:srgbClr"))
    alpha = etree.SubElement(srgb, qn("a:alpha"))
    alpha.set("val", "12000")

    # Move the mark to sit directly above the ground shape(s)
    tree = slide.shapes._spTree
    tree.remove(box._element)
    index = 2
    if grounds:
        index = list(tree).index(grounds[-1]._element) + 1
    tree.insert(index, box._element)

prs.save("deck.pptx")

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.oxml import parse_xml

prs = Presentation("deck.pptx")
W, H = prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height

def luminance(rgb):
    r, g, b = rgb[0], rgb[1], rgb[2]
    return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b

for slide in prs.slides:
    # The page's own ground is the last full-bleed "ground" shape; the mark
    # goes just above it so every piece of copy stays on top of the mark.
    grounds = [s for s in slide.shapes if "ground" in s.name.lower()]
    ground_rgb = (255, 255, 255)
    if grounds:
        try:
            ground_rgb = tuple(grounds[-1].fill.fore_color.rgb)
        except Exception:
            pass
    ink = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) if luminance(ground_rgb) < 128 else RGBColor(0x1D, 0x27, 0x33)

    box_w, box_h = Inches(9.0), Inches(2.4)
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(int((W - box_w) / 2), int((H - box_h) / 2), box_w, box_h)
    box.name = "ThinkSlides:watermark"
    box.rotation = -30
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = False
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    run = p.add_run()
    run.text = "DRAFT"
    run.font.size = Pt(150)
    run.font.bold = True
    run.font.color.rgb = ink
    # 12% opaque so the copy over it stays legible
    srgb = run._r.find(qn("a:rPr")).find(qn("a:solidFill")).find(qn("a:srgbClr"))
    srgb.append(parse_xml('<a:alpha xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" val="12000"/>'))

    # Move the mark to sit directly above the ground shape(s)
    tree = slide.shapes._spTree
    tree.remove(box._element)
    index = 2
    if grounds:
        index = list(tree).index(grounds[-1]._element) + 1
    tree.insert(index, box._element)

prs.save("deck.pptx")
